title: 09章、梦里花开苦情人
content_zh:
远处的身影在水面上小心翼翼地试探着。

    长春真气在足部按照特有的旋律运转，脚尖点在水波之上，可是神奇的事情发生了，自己，竟是可以稳稳当当地站立在水波之上。

    软软绵绵，柔柔糯糯就像是自己的足底和水波之上产生了一层隔膜，可以使自己在水上立足。

    张荼试着开始奔跑，腾挪，一切就像是排演了无数场的剧本一般，第一次，又像是有过无数次一般，轻车熟路，刻印在骨子里的本能一般。

    看着从如履薄冰到肆意奔跑的张荼，边关月由衷地露出一丝笑容。

    诸天授道。

    从来都不是局限的传承，而是因材施教，以朦胧的本心触碰最合适的传承，这才是诸天授道的恐怖之处。

    合适的，才是最好的。

    踏浪，孤影，逐月，神虚……

    边关月随意地便可想起诸多的步法，可是却是偏偏是这渡世步，只不过，不知道的是，最后他会选择渡人，还是渡己。

    “慈悲啊……”

    边关月看着张荼飘然远去的身影，不由得发出一声喟叹，不过随即似是发现了什么，嘴角浮起一丝有趣的弧度。

    看着夷水之上飘荡的诸多浮尸，张荼不禁蹙起了眉头。

    天地，终归是发生了异变。

    就算是溺水，也不可能没有一个幸存者的道理，更别说自己隐约看见有人幸运的落在了桥梁的残骸之上，可是如今却是一个人影都不见了。

    甚至说有不少的浮尸之上还有着些许狰狞的伤口，那是……

    齿痕！

    张荼第一反应感到一阵发寒，但是随即感受到了自己体内的力量，心中安定不少，额头上依旧是渗出丝丝汗水。

    未知的，才是可怕的。

    这水里有东西，心中随即一慌，步履也发生了些许的凌乱，可是随即，便是掩去了心中的怜悯之心。

    家都未曾庇护好，又何来心思庇护他人，为他人的血债而愤怒。

    家国天下，终究是家在前，还是国在前，张荼不明白。

    若是太平盛世，张荼可以理直气壮的喊出，国在家前，无国哪有家，可是如今国难当头，自己不过是一介匹夫，只求在这动荡之间，庇护好自己的至爱亲朋。

    可是，国都没有了，覆巢之下无完卵，自己当真能庇护的了么？

    原来，家国天下，这是进入骨子中的不可割舍，相互依存，相互成全。

    护国，安民，保家，平乱。

    收起无用的心思，张荼默默地计算着距离，心中迷茫，这还是昔日的母星么？

    莫不是，集体穿越？

    其实说不得张荼有这种质疑，如今的夷水，浩瀚得有点匪夷所思，这一望无际的波涛，浪花席卷之下，当真还是那孕育了一方水土的夷水么？

    心中默默地丈量，整个夷水，整整拓宽了十倍，张荼静默地站立在夷水之上，看着眼前的土地，满目的凄凉和荒凉，影影绰绰传来撕心裂肺的啼哭声。

    张荼无动于衷，快步地向着记忆中的方向快速地奔波而去。

    “这么大的土地，待到一切归于安宁，那可以种多少地粮食。”
content_en:
The distant figure cautiously explored the water.

    The Changchun Qi circulates in the feet according to a unique melody, and the toes point on the water waves, but something magical happens. I can actually stand firmly on the water waves.

    Soft, soft and waxy, it is like a layer of separation between the soles of your feet and the water waves, allowing you to gain a foothold on the water.

    Zhang Tu tried to start running and moving. Everything was like a script that had been rehearsed countless times. It was the first time and it seemed like it had happened countless times before. He was familiar with the road and it was an instinct engraved in his bones.

    Looking at Zhang Tu who had gone from walking on thin ice to running wildly, Bian Guanyue smiled sincerely.

    The gods teach the way.

    It is never a limited inheritance, but teaching students in accordance with their aptitude, and touching the most suitable inheritance with a vague original intention. This is the terrifying thing about the teachings of the gods.

    The right one is the best.

    Riding on the waves, a lonely shadow, chasing the moon, the spirit is empty...

    Bian Guanyue can think of many steps at will, but this is the step to cross the world. However, what she doesn't know is that in the end he will choose to cross others or himself.

    "Mercy..."

    Bian Guanyue looked at Zhang Tu's figure floating away, and couldn't help but let out a sigh, but then she seemed to have discovered something, and an interesting curve appeared at the corner of her mouth.

    Looking at the many floating corpses floating on the Yi River, Zhang Tu couldn't help but frown.

    After all, a change has occurred in the world.

    Even if it was drowning, there was no way there would be no survivors, not to mention that I vaguely saw someone lucky enough to land on the wreckage of the bridge, but now no one was missing.

    It is even said that there are a lot of floating corpses with some hideous wounds, that is...

    Teeth marks!

    Zhang Tu's first reaction was to feel a chill, but then he felt the power in his body, and felt much more at ease. There was still a trace of sweat on his forehead.

    The unknown is scary.

    There was something in the water, and I immediately panicked in my heart, and my steps became a little messy, but then I covered up the compassion in my heart.

    If your family has not protected you well, how can you care about protecting others and being angry for the blood debt of others?

    Zhang Tu doesn't understand whether family or country comes first.

    If there was peace and prosperity, Zhang Tu could confidently say that there is no home before the country. But now that the country is in crisis, he is just an ordinary man. He just wants to protect his beloved relatives and friends during this turmoil.

    However, the country is gone, and there are no intact eggs under the overturned nest. Can I really protect it?

    It turns out that family, country and world are inseparable from the core, interdependent and mutually fulfilling.

    Protect the country, stabilize the people, protect the family, and put an end to chaos.

    Putting away his useless thoughts, Zhang Tu silently calculated the distance, confused in his heart. Is this still the home planet of the past?

    Could it be, collective time travel?

    In fact, it is impossible to say that Zhang Tu has such doubts. Today's Yishui is a bit unbelievably vast. Is this endless wave, swept by the waves, really still the same Yishui that gave birth to a land and water?

    Silently measuring in his heart, the entire Yishui River was widened ten times. Zhang Tu stood silently on the Yishui River, looking at the land in front of him, which was full of desolation and desolation, and heart-wrenching cries could be heard vaguely.

    Zhang Tu remained indifferent and hurriedly ran towards the direction in his memory.

    "With such a big land, how much food can be grown when everything returns to peace."
title_en: Chapter 09, Flowers bloom in the dream and the bitter lover
